title: Commit flashlight gamepad toggle
objective: Create a local Git commit for the working flashlight gamepad toggle and FKey input fix.
instructions: Inspect git status and diff before staging.
Stage only the files directly related to the flashlight gamepad toggle/FKey fix, expected file: examples/flashlight/run.py.
Do not stage unrelated .control-tower packets, docs, pycache, or user changes.
Create a local commit with a concise message describing the flashlight gamepad toggle/input fix.
Report commit SHA, commit message, files committed, and any remaining unstaged changes.
definition_of_done: A local commit exists containing only the flashlight example gamepad toggle/input fix.
